openingLetter:
Some things don't need a special occasion.

Sometimes, you just want to make something for someone and let them know they're appreciated.
scrapbookIntroHeading: Tap any photograph to hold it a little closer.
mainReflection:
It's funny how you slowly became a part of my everyday life.

I didn't necessarily notice it happening. I just got used talking to you, sharing things, laughing at random nonsense, and having you around.

And eventually, I realize that your presence has become something I genuinely appreciate.
secondNote: Half of our best memories are just ordinary nights that turned into three-hour conversations about nothing at all. Somehow those are always the ones that stick.
hiddenFlowerNote: glad our paths crossed when they did, and that they're staying the same way.
hiddenEnvelopeNote: P.S. Thank you for sharing and ranting your completely unnecessary 20-minute stories like they actually matter.
endingLines: I'm genuinely glad that I'm one of your friends.
I just wanted to make something a little different for you.
I hope it made you smile.
endingSignOff: This little friendship, giving us a little happiness. Hope it continues the same way. ♡
